title: hv.lfo
description: precision LFOs based on sampled signal oscillators

arguments.description: wave shape, <sine, ramp, saw, square or pulse>

body: [hv.lfo] is a precise control rate LFO based on sampled signal oscillators, with sine, ramp, saw, square or pulse shapes. It outputs values between 0 and 1; the right inlet resets the phase, or sets the pulse width for the pulse shape.
